title: PyKeithley_DMM6500: Python control of the Keithley DMM6500 multimeter
description: A Python library for controlling the Keithley DMM6500 6.5-digit digital multimeter over Ethernet using TSP commands on a raw TCP socket — no VISA or vendor drivers required. Covers DC/AC voltage and current, 2- and 4-wire resistance, temperature, filters, NPLC, and trigger control, with Van der Pauw sheet-resistance measurement utilities and a command-line interface.
